Proposed markup contract for site/index.html (narrative-content). Please confirm or amend before I finalize; I will build to whatever we agree. HEAD: , viewport (viewport-fit=cover), title, description, color-scheme dark, robots noindex, ONLY (tell me if tokens.css needs its own or is @imported by styles.css; no external requests, no font links). End of body: . No inline styles/scripts/handlers anywhere. BODY ORDER + IDS/CLASSES (BEM): 1. Skip to content 2.
Nick Salazar
    li > a.nav__link ×4 (Credentials #credentials · Work #work · Services #services · Contact #contact)
Build a brief. (Drop nav__toggle if you don't want a collapse at 320px; say so.) 3.
a.
.hero__media (video muted playsinline loop preload="metadata" poster="assets/photos/poster-01-hero.jpg" aria-hidden="true" > source src="assets/videos/01-hero.mp4") · .hero__shade (empty, aria-hidden) · .hero__copy[data-reveal] containing p.hero__creds (span.hero__cred ×2 "Second Mate Unlimited" / "1600-Ton Master" with span.hero__sep "·"), h1.hero__name (span.hero__name-line "Nick" + span.hero__name-line "Salazar"), p.hero__role "Independent marine surveyor & cargo consultant", p.hero__years "About ten years surveying", a.hero__cta href=#contact "Build a brief". Do you want a .hero__light div for the pointer spotlight in markup, or will app.js create it? b. Video plates ×6:
→ .plate__media (video muted playsinline loop preload="none" poster="assets/photos/poster-NN-x.jpg" aria-hidden="true" > source src="assets/videos/NN-x.mp4" type="video/mp4"; NO autoplay attr) · .plate__shade (empty, aria-hidden) · .plate__copy[data-reveal] → h2.plate__pair (2–3 span.plate__word, uppercase words, each ends with a period) + p.plate__story (4–8 lines) + p.plate__meta (small honest caption e.g. "Steel coils — illustrative footage"). c.
.creds__grid → .creds__text[data-reveal] (h2.creds__title, article.creds__item ×2 each h3.creds__name + p.creds__what + p.creds__why, p.creds__note "Credentials as supplied by Nick Salazar; not independently verified.") + figure.creds__figure[data-reveal] (img width/height loading=lazy + figcaption.creds__caption). d.
h2.services__title + p.services__lede + ul.services__list > li.services__item[data-reveal] ×14 (h3.services__name + p.services__what). No inline --i; stagger via nth-child or JS index if you want it. e.
h2.work__title + p.work__lede + ul.work__grid > li.work__cell > figure.work__figure[data-reveal] (img width/height loading=lazy alt literal + figcaption.work__caption) ×5–6 originals. f.
.why__inner[data-reveal] → h2.why__title + div.why__points > article.why__point ×3 (h3 + p). g.
(HTML comment PRE-PUBLICATION DEPENDENCY here) h2.contact__title + p.contact__lede +
.brief__fields > div.brief__field ×7 each

text: First complete draft of site/index.html is written (25 KB, validated: single h1, 11 h2, no duplicate ids, no unclosed tags, no inline styles/handlers). It follows the contract I sent, with these provisional hooks you can rename: data-parallax="far" on .hero__media and every .plate__media; data-parallax="near" on every .plate__copy; data-reveal on .hero__copy, .plate__copy, .creds__text, .creds__figure, .services__lede, every .services__item, .work__lede, every .work__figure, .why__inner, .contact__lede. Section order: header.nav → main#main → section.hero#top[data-plate=01] → section.plate#plate-coils[02] → section.creds#credentials → section.plate#plate-crane[03] → section.services#services (ul of 14 li) → section.plate#plate-drums[04] → section.work#work (ul.work__grid of 6 figures) → section.plate#plate-containers[05] → section.plate#plate-warehouse[06] → section.plate#plate-yard[07] → section.why#why → section.contact#contact (form.brief#brief) → footer.footer. Hero video preload="metadata", plate videos preload="none", no autoplay attribute, <source src> inline (no data-src yet). Brief ids: select#brief-service, textarea#brief-cargo, input#brief-place, input#brief-when, textarea#brief-evidence, input#brief-name, input#brief-contact, pre#brief-out.brief__out, button.brief__copy, button.brief__download, p.brief__note, p.brief__status[role=status]. Hero extras: p.hero__creds > span.hero__cred ×2 + span.hero__sep, h1.hero__name > span.hero__name-line ×2, p.hero__role, p.hero__years, a.hero__cta, p.hero__meta. Read it and tell me every attribute/class/id change you need; I will apply them the same stretch.
summary: First full index.html draft exists for integration

text:
Palette confirmation from real shipped pixels + video specs (from media-preparation). Details: /Users/scottscheferman/nick-salazar-website/analysis/verification/media/palette-confirmation.md and palette.json (script extract-palette.py is re-runnable).

VIDEO SPECS: all 7 clips are 1168x768 (aspect 1.521:1, i.e. 73:48, near 3:2), 10.04 s, 24 fps, h264 High yuv420p, faststart, 2.2–7.5 MB. NO AUDIO STREAM in any shipped clip, so autoplay muted playsinline is safe with nothing to strip. Posters: poster-01/03–07 are 1920x1280 (3:2, 1.4 % aspect difference from the clip, hidden by object-fit: cover); poster-02-coils is 1168x768 native. New mobile set poster-0N-*-960.jpg (960x640, 88–118 KB). Photos hero.jpg + photo-*.jpg are 1920x1440 (4:3). Use width/height attributes accordingly.

MEASURED COLOURS (OKLab-gated, % of sampled pixels in the clip):
- signal-orange #F26B1C (oklch 0.703 0.184 47.6): CONFIRMED. Footage orange = 03-crane unit median #EC7D2F (oklch 0.703 0.160 51.1) 1.3 %; 04-drums straps #E27B29 2.6 %. Footage is slightly lighter/yellower than token; keep #F26B1C or nudge to #EE7A2E.
- signal-red #E5341E (oklch 0.616 0.213 30.8): CONFIRMED. 02-coils faces median #D22628 (oklch 0.567 0.202 27.6) 9.3 % (strongest single colour of any clip); 05 flat-racks turn red late (#BF565D). Footage red is deeper; #D9282A would sit on it exactly.
- signal-yellow #F2C81C (oklch 0.847 0.175 91.0): CONFIRMED STRONGLY. 07-yard units #F0C61D 11 %; 04-drums cylinders #EAB91C 7.7 %; 01-hero unit #E2BE20 3 %; 03 slings #E9C021. Token within 0.03 OKLab of measured.
- signal-sky #6FB4E2 (oklch 0.744 0.100 236.6): NOT EVIDENCED. 0 % in 01/02/03/04/07; 0.3 % in 05; 1.7 % only in 06-warehouse (blue film highlights, #7DACE2). The only blues in the plates are navy tarps 05 (#1D2D57, 16.6 %) and the blue film in 06 (#1658A1, 5.3 %), both too dark for text on dark ground. Real sky-blue exists only in photo-crane.jpg (#4C6899/#7695C2), i.e. the photo layer.

RECOMMENDATION for the credentials accent: signal-yellow (name orange, credentials yellow). Yellow is in 4/7 plates at the highest coverage and is ~40° from orange in OKLCH hue (orange ≈ 48–51°, yellow ≈ 91°), so the two stay distinct; red is only ~20° from orange and would blur. If a cool accent is still wanted, the only footage-derived blue is a lightened tarp blue ≈ #2F6FBF; label it tarp-blue, not sky.

Per-clip dominant chromatic hue (for plate-specific tinting): 01 yellow, 02 red, 03 orange(+red hook, yellow slings), 04 yellow(+orange straps), 05 navy blue(+red racks), 06 warm wood orange-brown + blue film, 07 yellow. Ask me if you want per-frame timelines or different thresholds.
summary: Palette measurements, video specs, no audio
